rules.rule: Flag a concrete process tree or PID reuse scenario that double-counts RAM, drops the server/TUI boundary, misattributes orphaned terminal daemons, or trusts an unverified server PID. Identify the expected and erroneous totals.
Flag changes that accidentally expose a server or package-root entrypoint, use an incompatible V2 cli.json installation shape, or break the built TUI export. This package is intentionally TUI-only.

Flag a supported Linux/Windows command or parsing case that breaks process probing, allows overlapping polls, leaks timers, or produces invalid width-bound output. Provide a platform-specific failing example rather than general portability speculation.
